candidate_scope: BRIGHT_supplement_v1 train candidates versus event-group-v1 val/test
evidence: All three retained pairs were train-test medium-risk candidates produced by patch similarity.
Two pairs had zero RANSAC inliers and one had only two; none had stable local geometry.
Visual review found different geography, road/building layouts, and land cover. Diagonal no-data boundaries caused the false-positive retrievals.
